title: By 18 months, most children push a toy car in simple play
summary: The CDC says that by 18 months, most children play with toys in a simple way, like pushing a toy car.
body: The CDC's cognitive milestones for 18 months include playing with toys in a simple way, and the printed example is pushing a toy car. The line is ordinary play with an object, on the US list of what most children do by that age. It does not say how hard a push must be, and it does not grade a child who plays another way. The line does not set a force and does not grade another style of play.

sources.title: Milestones by 18 Months
